About the jobDesign products people want to use in real life
Unreal Urban builds technology that brings people, communities and cities together. Our first flagship product, Falorin, is a live web and mobile platform for discovering, creating and joining real-world experiences.

We are looking for a hands-on Founding Product / UX Designer to make Falorin clearer, more useful and more delightful at every step—from first discovery to creating or joining an experience. You will help turn real user behaviour and community insight into simple, high-quality product experiences.

This is an early-stage, equity-based collaboration; there is no cash salary at this stage. Equity will be discussed transparently with strong candidates based on scope, commitment and contribution.

What you'll do

- Own end-to-end product and UX design for Falorin across web and mobile.

- Turn user research, feedback and behavioural data into flows, prototypes and polished interfaces.

- Simplify the critical journeys: discovery, onboarding, creation, joining and returning.

- Work directly with founders, engineering and growth to prioritise the highest-impact product improvements.

- Help establish a flexible design system that can support future Unreal Urban products.

What we're looking for

- Strong portfolio of product/UX work for consumer, marketplace, social or mobile products.

- Excellent user-flow, interaction and visual design judgement.

- Comfortable moving from problem framing and quick prototypes to implementation-ready detail.

- Practical fluency with Figma and close collaboration with developers.

- Curious about how digital products can improve real-world connection.

Why join
You will shape a live flagship product at an important early stage, with real ownership over what users see, feel and do. Your work on Falorin can become the design foundation for a broader Unreal Urban portfolio.

A systems thinker with an obsessive attention to detail and a love for documentation. Experience collaborating cross-functionally with engineering and design teams. Prior experience maintaining or contributing to a cross-platform(multi brand) design system. Experience with motion design for micro-interactions. You have a good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScriptWhy You'll Love Working at Fynd A growing design culture with ambitious, supportive teammates. Opportunity to work on a large-scale design system used across multiple industries, products and surfaces. Ownership, autonomy, and the ability to influence system strategy and evolution. Job DescriptionDesigner, Content Production As one of the worlds leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco. Job Description Who we are With over $1.58 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the worlds leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 26 countries and with over 8400 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the worlds leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco. Your Team In support of Invescos position as a leading independent global investment management company which provides a comprehensive array of enduring investment solutions for retail, institutional and high net worth clients around the world, this position is responsible for executing marketing communications including high-level print and electronic production & multi-media support, while providing expert support in industry-specific programs, file management and work processes in support of the companys marketing/sales initiatives and regulatory requirements. Your Role Design and produce marketing collateral, brochures, infographics, forms, electronic corporate presentation materials and other digital and print communication materials, under minimal supervision Ensure all deliverables comply with brand guidelines, meet quality standards and production requirements through thorough self-review to ensure accuracy and consistency Manage multiple projects simultaneously, assess requirements, and deliver work within established timelines Take ownership of assigned projects from initiation through completion while meeting agreed timelines and stakeholder expectations Leverage AI-enabled productivity and design tools to improve efficiency, creativity, and turnaround times while maintaining quality standards. Follow diligent file management / organizes & archives files according to established departmental processes Become proficient in utilizing web-based job trafficking system (Aprimo) to manage all production tasks The Experience You Bring 2+ years of experience in graphic design, content production, or creative services supporting multiple projects in a fast-paced environment Strong understanding of graphic design principles, typography, layout, branding, print production, video editing and motion graphics creation Proficiency in Adobe CC tools, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat, Premier and After Effects Experience with video editing, motion graphics, and multimedia content development is a plus. Knowledge in producing/editing HTML5/CSS3 email templates / banners is added advantage Exposure to Adobe Firefly, Generative AI tools, and AI-powered video editing platforms will be a plus Skills/Other Personal Attributes Required: Ability to work independently and with the team; flexible to work on multiple projects and meet tight deadlines maintaining quality standards Ability to review/troubleshoot files and provide effective, thoughtful solutions to issues in a professional and productive manner Effectively communicate with a variety of individuals at all technical levels across our global network Team player  ability to communicate and work effectively as part of a team Open minded, flexible, and willing to listen to other opinions Strong organizational skills and detail oriented Academic requirements An Associate's degree in graphic design, visual communications or related field preferred. Two years of work experience in technical graphic design & content production/page layout/file management may be considered in lieu of educational requirements. Full Time / Part Time Full time Worker Type Employee Job Exempt (Yes / No) No Workplace Model At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office. Why Invesco In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each others identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by .

Job DescriptionJob Title: UI/UX Designer
Experience: 2 Years to 5 Years

Work Mode: Full-time (On-site)

Job Summary
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer with strong handson experience in designing intuitive digital experiences. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of usercentered design principles along with practical knowledge of image cleaning, visual enhancement, and basic video concepts to support modern digital product requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Design user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces for web and mobile applications
Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs using design tools
Ensure a seamless user experience through research, user flows, and usability best practices
Work closely with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality design solutions
Perform image cleaning, retouching, and optimization for digital assets
Support basic video editing or motion-related design requirements for product/marketing content
Maintain consistency in design systems, typography, color schemes, and branding guidelines
Conduct usability testing and iterate designs based on feedback
Stay updated with latest UI/UX trends, tools, and technologies

Required Skills & Qualifications

2 to 5 years of proven experience in UI/UX design
Strong portfolio showcasing UI/UX projects
Proficiency in tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator (or similar)
Hands-on experience in image editing / image cleaning (background removal, retouching, enhancement)
Basic understanding of video editing or motion graphics concepts (After Effects/Premiere Pro is a plus)
Strong understanding of user-centered design principles
Good communication and collaboration skills
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

Good to Have

Experience in design systems and component libraries
Knowledge of HTML/CSS basics
Familiarity with agile development environments
Understanding of branding and digital marketing design needs

About Us

At Sellergize, we build and offer a complete stack of Technology Products & Services to scale the customer's Affiliate marketing business.

Job Description

We are looking for UI / UX Designers to add life & excitement to our product, and yet keep it simple to operate. We have planned some really innovative features.

Your role in this project will be to create interactive designs and give a magical experience to all our visitors in each flow. These designs will not be limited to just the website & app, but also stretch into integrations with various bots and third-party tools.

This role is ideal for young designers who want to work on a high-growth B2C project and would love to be part of product management of a high-traffic app (we're targeting 50M users by the end of this year alone).

You will be working with the product team to finalise the features, then create multiple design options, and also work with the front-end developers to make sure the designs are correctly implemented. You will also be responsible for identifying UX issues in the live applications from time to time and give smart solutions.

You will also be responsible for approval of graphic designs for use on our Website, Apps, Email newsletters, App notifications, Social Media, etc.

Key Responsibilities:

-
Designing end-to-end experiences across iOS, Android, and web  from early concepts to production-ready specs.
-
Collaborating closely with product managers and engineers to understand goals, surface edge cases, and ship great work together.
- Owning the visual craft  crafting high-fidelity UI that's clean, consistent, and meticulously detailed in every state and interaction.
- Building and maintaining our design system in Figma  components, tokens, variants, documentation, and everything in between.
- Creating and managing Figma prototypes that communicate interaction flows clearly to stakeholders and developers.
- Conducting user research and usability testing to validate ideas, uncover pain points, and continuously raise the quality bar.
- Keeping Figma files clean and well-organized with structured naming, proper component usage, and scalable file management.
- Incorporating AI-aware design thinking  staying current on how AI features and interaction patterns show up in modern product experiences.
- Iterating based on feedback and data  you treat your designs as living work, not final deliverables.

Requirements

- 25 years of experience in UI/UX design, with a portfolio that demonstrates solid visual craft, design thinking, and real collaboration.

- Exceptional attention to detail  you notice when something is off by 2px, and it bothers you enough to fix it.

- Strong visual design skills  typography, layout, colour, spacing, and iconography are things you actively care about and do well.

- Deep expertise in Figma  prototyping, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and design system management.

- Experience designing for iOS and Android  you understand platform conventions, gesture patterns, and mobile-first thinking.

- Experience creating and maintaining a Figma design system  not just using one, but building and owning one.

- Track record of working in fast-paced teams and collaborating actively with product and engineering throughout the design and build process.

- Basic understanding of AI and its role in product design  familiarity with AI interaction patterns and how to design for intelligent features.

- Excellent communication skills  you can articulate your design decisions clearly to engineers, PMs, and leadership alike.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Product Designer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing user-centric, visually appealing, and functional products. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the user experience and interface while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

RequirementsDesign Conceptualization Create wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to communicate and test design concepts.

Collaborate with stakeholders to iterate on design solutions based on feedback and data.

Copywriting Write clear, engaging, and user-focused copy that complements the design and guides users effectively.

Ensure consistency and alignment with the products tone and brand voice.

Data-Driven Design Use analytics and user data to refine user flows and optimize the product experience.

Continuously evaluate product performance and make informed design adjustments.

UX/UI Design Design intuitive and visually compelling user interfaces that align with business goals.

Map out seamless user flows that improve engagement and satisfaction.

Animation & Motion Create immersive animations and motion graphics that amplify the product experience

Collaboration Partner with product managers to align on requirements and goals.

Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs and copy.

Continuous Improvement Incorporate feedback from testing and data analysis to refine designs and user flows.

Stay informed on design trends and best practices to bring fresh ideas to the team.
Requirements

3+ years of proven experience in UX/UI, motion & product design.

Proficiency in design tools like Figma.

Strong understanding of user-centered design principles.

Ability to create wireframes, prototypes, and detailed design specifications.

Excellent communication and teamwork skills to work with cross-functional teams.

Ability to present and justify design decisions to stakeholders.

Analytical mindset with a focus on user needs and business goals.

Creative problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

We are looking for a person who can adapt to the latest AI technologies, such as ChatGPT, and leverage them to enhance their productivity and efficiency.
BenefitsMentorship: Work next to some of the best engineers and designers.

Freedom: An environment where you get to practice your craft. No micromanagement.

Growth: A tailor-made program to help you achieve your career goals.

A voice that is heard: We don't claim to know the best way of doing things. We like to listen to ideas from our team. .

We are seeking a talented and creative Graphic Designer to join our dynamic team at our Hyderabad office. Qualifications and Skills

Proficient in design systems, with the ability to maintain cohesive visual languages across products.
Solid experience in web design, focusing on user experience and accessibility for diverse audiences.
Skilled in creating detailed and engaging illustrations that enhance brand identity and storytelling.
Expertise in visual communication, translating complex ideas into clear, appealing graphics
Strong understanding of branding principles, ensuring design consistency across all visual media
Proficient in UI/UX design, with a strong focus on user-centered design principles
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to align design goals with business objectives.
Excellent time management skills, capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Roles and Responsibilities

Develop and refine creative design solutions in collaboration with marketing and product teams.
Produce high-quality digital assets across various platforms, ensuring consistency and excellence.
Conduct research to understand market trends and user preferences, incorporating insights into designs.
Maintain and evolve design systems, contributing to the overall visual identity of the company.
Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are feasible and accurately implemented.
Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute with innovative ideas and creative solutions.
Present design concepts to stakeholders, incorporating feedback to enhance the final product.
Ensure all designs comply with legal standards and company policies regarding brand representation. .

Graphic Designer Jobs in Hyderabad FAQ's- How can I find a graphic designing job in Hyderabad?
Candidates generally look for better job opportunities in Hyderabad since the city offers giant IT tycoons and other industries. Designers in the city are in demand considering all Industries present. People can search for vacancies by signing in different job portals and registering with premium consultancies. Moreover, applying on the company's website and contacting recruiters via emails can help find the job easier.

- Is relocating to Hyderabad a good option?
Home to upscale restaurants and shops, Hyderabad is the city which offers a positive and suitable environment for candidates who migrate from other cities. The growth opportunities are high with attractive multinational corporates. People generally locate to Hyderabad because it is way cheaper than other metro cities and even convenient to afford in every aspect.

- How is the work environment in Hyderabad?
Like other prospective cities in India, Hyderabad offers fixed working time from 9 to 6 hours in a day along with flexible night shift options in some premium companies. The town is safe for women and offers impressive climate compared to northern Indian cities.

- what is the salary range of a graphic designer?
The salary for a graphic designer in India initially starts from INR 2 to 3 lakh per annum. if the candidate is well experienced, it often extends between INR 4 lakh to 6 Lakh per annum. Besides, It depends upon your work skills if you are a proficient designer, then it can range more than the average salary.

Job DescriptionAbout the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Motion Graphics Designer & Animator to bring our mobile app and brand to life through engaging, high-quality animations. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of motion design, UI animations, storytelling, and visual aesthetics, with the ability to create smooth, modern, and premium animations for both the app and social media.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and create high-quality 2D motion graphics and animations.
* Create engaging animations for the mobile app, including:
* Onboarding screens
* Splash screens
* UI transitions
* Micro-interactions
* Loading animations
* Feature demonstrations
* In-app promotional animations
* Produce promotional videos and animated content for social media.
* Collaborate with the UI/UX and product team to create seamless user experiences.
* Maintain consistency with the apps branding and design language.
* Optimize animations for mobile performance without compromising quality.
* Deliver assets in multiple formats suitable for Android, iOS, and marketing platforms.
* Revise designs based on feedback and meet project deadlines.

Requirements

* Minimum 3 years of experience in Motion Graphics and Animation.
* Strong portfolio showcasing motion graphics, UI animations, and promotional videos.
* Proficiency in:
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Figma
* Lottie (Bodymovin)
* Knowledge of animation principles, timing, easing, and storytelling.
* Experience creating animations for mobile applications.
* Understanding of responsive design and mobile UI/UX.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to delivering polished, qualified work.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with Rive animations.
* Basic knowledge of Blender or Cinema 4D.
* Experience creating app explainer videos.
* Understanding of branding and visual identity.
* Familiarity with exporting assets for developers (JSON/Lottie, GIF, MP4, SVG).

What Were Looking For

* A creative thinker with a modern design sense.
* Someone who can transform ideas into visually engaging animations.
* Passion for creating premium, clean, and user-friendly experiences.
* Ability to take ownership of projects and suggest creative improvements.
* Someone who stays updated with the latest animation and design trends.

Portfolio Requirement

Applicants must submit a portfolio showcasing:

* Motion graphics projects
* Mobile app animations
* UI micro-interactions
* Promotional or advertisement videos
* Social media animations

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. .

Job DescriptionSummary:
As a Graphic Designer at Appizion Consulting & Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the visual identity and creative output of our client-facing projects across diverse industries. This entry-level position is ideal for a creative, detail-oriented individual eager to grow within a dynamic consulting environment. You will collaborate closely with marketing, strategy, and design teams to develop compelling visual content that enhances brand messaging, supports client presentations, and drives engagement. From concept to execution, your work will contribute directly to the success of high-impact consulting deliverables, including pitch decks, infographics, reports, digital assets, and social media content. This role offers a unique prospect to build a solid foundation in skilled design while working on real-world business challenges in a fast-paced, innovative setting.

Responsibilities:
Design visually engaging and brand-consistent graphics for client presentations, reports, proposals, and digital platforms.
Create infographics, charts, diagrams, and data visualizations that simplify complex information for clarity and impact.
Collaborate with consultants and project managers to understand business objectives and translate them into compelling visual narratives.
Maintain and update brand guidelines, templates, and design libraries to ensure consistency across all deliverables.
Produce high-quality digital assets for web, social media, email campaigns, and print materials.
Participate in creative brainstorming sessions and provide design input during project planning stages.
Stay updated on design trends, tools, and best practices to continuously improve design quality and efficiency.
Manage multiple projects with competing deadlines, ensuring timely delivery without compromising on quality.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
Proficiency in industry-standard design t .

Graphic Designer Jobs in Hyderabad FAQ's- How can I find a graphic designing job in Hyderabad?
Candidates generally look for better job opportunities in Hyderabad since the city offers giant IT tycoons and other industries. Designers in the city are in demand considering all Industries present. People can search for vacancies by signing in different job portals and registering with premium consultancies. Moreover, applying on the company's website and contacting recruiters via emails can help find the job easier.

- Is relocating to Hyderabad a good option?
Home to upscale restaurants and shops, Hyderabad is the city which offers a positive and suitable environment for candidates who migrate from other cities. The growth opportunities are high with attractive multinational corporates. People generally locate to Hyderabad because it is way cheaper than other metro cities and even convenient to afford in every aspect.

- How is the work environment in Hyderabad?
Like other prospective cities in India, Hyderabad offers fixed working time from 9 to 6 hours in a day along with flexible night shift options in some premium companies. The town is safe for women and offers impressive climate compared to northern Indian cities.

- what is the salary range of a graphic designer?
The salary for a graphic designer in India initially starts from INR 2 to 3 lakh per annum. if the candidate is well experienced, it often extends between INR 4 lakh to 6 Lakh per annum. Besides, It depends upon your work skills if you are a proficient designer, then it can range more than the average salary.

Were looking for a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer & Content Creator to help bring our brand, campaigns, and marketing ideas to life across digital, print, video, and event channels.
This role is ideal for someone who can design polished, professional marketing assets while also thinking strategically about how creative supports engagement, lead generation, and brand consistency. Youll create visuals for social media, email, web pages, digital ads, print materials, tradeshow displays, lead magnets, and more.
The right person is highly creative, organized, comfortable working across multiple formats, and able to take a campaign idea from concept to finished creative. Some copywriting experience is important, since many projects will require light headline writing, ad copy support, captions, layout copy, and content refinement.

About Pragmatyc

Pragmatyc is a software delivery company partnering with clients across industries — from smart building and smart city platforms to enterprise SaaS products — to design and ship reliable, user-centric digital solutions. We work closely with cross-functional delivery teams to turn complex business requirements into intuitive, well-engineered products.

Role Summary

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can translate business and user requirements into clean, intuitive, and visually compelling digital experiences. You will work closely with delivery managers, product owners, and engineering teams across multiple concurrent client and internal projects — covering web apps, mobile apps, and enterprise dashboards — taking designs from early wireframes through to polished, developer-ready UI.

Key Responsibilities

- Translate requirements, user stories, and stakeholder input into wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity UI designs.

- Design responsive web and mobile interfaces that are consistent, accessible, and aligned with brand guidelines.

- Build and maintain design systems / component libraries to ensure consistency across products and projects.

- Create interactive prototypes to communicate design intent and validate flows before development.

- Collaborate with delivery managers and developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately.

- Conduct usability reviews and incorporate feedback from stakeholders, clients, and end users.

- Work across multiple concurrent projects, balancing client-specific branding with reusable design patterns.

- Prepare client-facing design assets and presentations that clearly communicate design rationale.

- Stay current with UI/UX trends, accessibility standards, and platform-specific design guidelines (Material, iOS HIG, etc.).

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 2–5 years of professional experience in UI/UX design for web and/or mobile products.

- Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process: research, wireframing, prototyping, and final UI.

- Proficiency in Figma (required); familiarity with Adobe XD or Sketch is a plus.

- Solid understanding of responsive design, design systems, and accessibility (WCAG) principles.

- Ability to create and maintain component libraries and design tokens.

- Working knowledge of user research and usability testing methods.

- Strong communication skills to present and defend design decisions to clients and internal stakeholders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-project delivery environment with shifting priorities.

Good to Have

- Experience designing for enterprise, B2B, or SaaS platforms.

- Basic understanding of front-end constraints (HTML/CSS) to design realistic, implementable UI.

- Exposure to design collaboration tools such as Zeplin, Storybook, or similar handoff tools.

- Experience working with Agile delivery teams and tools like Jira/Zoho Sprints.

What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on diverse, high-impact projects across industries and geographies.

- A collaborative team culture with direct exposure to clients and end-to-end product delivery.

- Room to shape design processes and systems as the design function scales.

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience and market standards.

Elevate Your Career, Accelerate Your Potential at Pragmatyc.

Full job description
Job Title: UI/UX Designer
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and user-focused UI/UX Designer to design intuitive, attractive, and user-friendly digital experiences for websites, mobile applications, and software products. The candidate will work closely with developers, product managers, and other teams to create designs that meet both user and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

- Design user-friendly interfaces for websites, mobile applications, and software products.

- Conduct user research and understand user needs, behaviour, and expectations.

- Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, mockups, and high-fidelity designs.

- Develop responsive and visually appealing UI designs.

- Create and maintain design systems, style guides, and reusable components.

- Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs.

- Conduct usability testing and improve designs based on user feedback.

- Identify user experience issues and recommend effective solutions.

- Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate user journeys and product functionality.

- Maintain consistency in branding, typography, colours, layouts, and visual elements.

- Review completed designs and ensure they match approved specifications.

- Stay updated with the latest UI/UX trends, tools, and design best practices.

Required Skills

- Strong knowledge of Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, Photoshop, or similar design tools.

- Good understanding of UI/UX principles and design processes.

- Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and design systems.

- Good understanding of responsive and mobile-first design.

- Strong knowledge of typography, colour theory, layouts, and visual hierarchy.

- Good problem-solving and creative-thinking skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Good communication and teamwork skills.

- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and front-end development is an advantage.

Qualification & Experience

- Bachelor's/Diploma degree in UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Experience: 1–4 years of relevant experience preferred.

- Freshers with a strong portfolio and knowledge of UI/UX tools may also apply.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV and UI/UX portfolio with the HR Department.

Job Title: UI/UX Designer
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and user-focused UI/UX Designer to design intuitive, attractive, and user-friendly digital experiences for websites, mobile applications, and software products. The candidate will work closely with developers, product managers, and other teams to create designs that meet both user and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

- Design user-friendly interfaces for websites, mobile applications, and software products.

- Conduct user research and understand user needs, behaviour, and expectations.

- Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, mockups, and high-fidelity designs.

- Develop responsive and visually appealing UI designs.

- Create and maintain design systems, style guides, and reusable components.

- Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs.

- Conduct usability testing and improve designs based on user feedback.

- Identify user experience issues and recommend effective solutions.

- Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate user journeys and product functionality.

- Maintain consistency in branding, typography, colours, layouts, and visual elements.

- Review completed designs and ensure they match approved specifications.

- Stay updated with the latest UI/UX trends, tools, and design best practices.

Required Skills

- Strong knowledge of Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, Photoshop, or similar design tools.

- Good understanding of UI/UX principles and design processes.

- Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and design systems.

- Good understanding of responsive and mobile-first design.

- Strong knowledge of typography, colour theory, layouts, and visual hierarchy.

- Good problem-solving and creative-thinking skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Good communication and teamwork skills.

- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and front-end development is an advantage.

Qualification & Experience

- Bachelor's/Diploma degree in UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Experience: 1–4 years of relevant experience preferred.

- Freshers with a strong portfolio and knowledge of UI/UX tools may also apply.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV and UI/UX portfolio with the HR Department.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and skilled Graphic Designer with at least 2 years of professional experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for design, attention to detail, and the ability to create engaging visual content across digital and print platforms.

Key Responsibilities

- Create visually appealing designs for social media, websites, advertisements, presentations, brochures, and other marketing materials.

- Develop creative concepts based on project requirements and brand guidelines.

- Design social media posts, banners, promotional creatives, and digital campaigns.

- Collaborate with the marketing and content teams to understand design requirements.

- Maintain consistency in branding, colors, typography, and visual style.

- Edit and enhance images, graphics, and other visual assets as required.

- Manage multiple design projects and deliver work within deadlines.

- Stay updated with current design trends and industry best practices.

- Take feedback positively and make revisions as required.

Required Skills

- 2+ years of professional experience as a Graphic Designer or in a similar role.

- Strong knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.

- Experience with Figma, Canva, or other design tools is an added advantage.

- Good understanding of typography, color theory, composition, and visual hierarchy.

- Strong creativity and attention to detail.

- Ability to understand briefs and convert ideas into effective visual designs.

- Good communication and teamwork skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

- Knowledge of social media design and digital marketing creatives.

Qualification

- Bachelor's degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field is preferred.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating relevant design work is required.

What We Are Looking For

- Creative thinker with a strong design sense.

- Proactive and willing to learn new tools and techniques.

- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

- Professional approach toward deadlines and feedback.

- Strong attention to detail and consistency.

title: Education Designer UX UI and AI
description:
You're a designer who has facilitated workshops or built online courses, and you noticed thatÂ you loved it and that you were unusually good at it.
You know how to make complex skills easy to learn, and how to guide people in applying their new skills. As one of our Education Designers, you'll structure and create the courses and Master Classes you lead.
You've taught design or AI to hundreds of people. Now you get the opportunity toÂ teach it to hundreds of thousandsÂ of learners around the world.
You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.
The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.
Youâll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.
Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI EducationIxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help usÂ take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.
At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.
We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.
With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.
We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial TeamWe're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:
- Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.Â This is the role described here.

- Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with ourÂ Education Designers.

- Our Course Writers and Editors:Â lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

Weâre a flexible team, and youâll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.
You, the Education Designer,Â establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course. You create the sequences, exercises, templates, and assessments. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, and theÂ Course Directors, who lead on what we teach and who teaches it, and you'll have a real say in both. We all reach out to and collaborate with industry leaders in these processes. Once your course is ready, ourÂ Course Writers and EditorsÂ take it the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.
Your Role at IxDF- Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

- Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, you'll teach both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

- Make an impact as you decide how the courses you lead come together.Â You establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course, then you plan, structure, and create the core content that gets them there. What comes first, what builds on what, and how people level up step by step with ease and joy from confused to competent. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

- Design the exercises, portfolio activities, design templates, and assessments thatÂ turn passive watching into active designing. You write the exercises that make a course participant apply an idea to their own portfolio project, the templates that scaffold that work, and the assessments that reveal whether they understood and can apply it, or whether they just watched. You write the headings and hooks your structure calls for, and our Course Writers and Editors own the final wording. Every course should leave a participant with a portfolio case study they can show a hiring manager.

- Set and raise the standard for our assessments,Â so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests.

- Make expert knowledge understandable.Â You take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches timeless human-centered design and AI.

- You help produce Master Classes.Â We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously: with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Course Directors and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

- YouÂ plan the course content in collaboration with the global industry leadersÂ in design and thenÂ fly out to meet them in professional studios across the world. You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

- Our courses combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective. You'll also work closely with our growth team.

- Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus onÂ one large course creation project per quarter, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published.

- Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

- Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

- You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the structure: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether it holds together. That kind of judgment takes twenty years to build, and this type of collaboration is one of the fastest ways to grow your own design skills. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll grow personally and professionally.

- Weâre committed toâ¯excellence,Â and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

- We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You- You have at leastÂ 5 years of hands-on design experience.

- You'veÂ facilitated workshopsÂ repeatedly, run a beginner course, mentored designers, or built curricula for online courses.

- You canÂ show us something you built: a course, a workshop series, live Master Classes, an AI teaching app, or a mentoring program. Weâre excited to hear what it was, why you built it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

- You can take aÂ broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequenceÂ thatâll make a beginner feel and act confident.

- You can teach the same idea in different formats: a 60-minute workshop, a written lesson, a 90-second video. You know what a medium does well and what it can't carry, and you know what to cut when the format gets shorter.

- You're aÂ practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

- YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, so theÂ outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

- You know the difference betweenÂ timeless human-centered design skills and skills in tools that change. Youâre passionate about the first, because theyâre the most interesting to you and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon. Youâre eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

- You canÂ teach a career changerÂ the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ guide an experienced designerÂ in upskilling to a more senior role.

- You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education.

- You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathyÂ to engage well with very different kinds of people.

- You'reÂ fluent in written and spoken EnglishÂ and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

- Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

- YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

- YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals. You give constructive feedback that others can act on, and you take it the same way. When someone shows you how your idea could be better, you're interested rather than defensive.

- You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

- Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

- Most of the work happens from yourÂ home office,Â but you'reÂ willing to travel a few times a yearÂ to shoot courses. You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

Bonus PointsNone of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.
- You'veÂ publishedÂ educational material under your own name orÂ spokenÂ at design conferences.

- You've worked with anÂ LMS or an online learning platform.

- You'veÂ built AI-supported learning: tutors, adaptive paths, automated feedback. Or youâve used AI to build products.

- You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ in UX, UI, AI, or a similar field.

- You have yourÂ own blog or social media pageÂ where you create and share original content.

- You haveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

What We Can Offer- A highly valued role:Â You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

- Reach and impactÂ that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. A workshop facilitator might teach one hundred designers a year. Your design decisions will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

- Access:Â The experts you'd normally cite in a workshop are the people whose material you'll be shaping, whose Master Classes you'll produce, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling.

- Autonomy:Â Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses teach.

- A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world, and make it accessible for everyone.

title: Product Builder (UI/UX Designer & Mobile App Developer) - (m/w/d)
description:
*Luma Life entwickelt eine KI-basierte Alltagsbegleitung für Menschen mit Demenz.* Unser Ziel: Menschen mit Demenz ein möglichst selbstbestimmtes Leben ermöglichen und Angehörige im Alltag entlasten.

Wir sind ein Early-Stage-Startup mit funktionierendem Produkt, ersten Nutzern und starken Partnern. Bei uns arbeitest du direkt mit den Foundern, übernimmst echte Verantwortung und kannst deine Ideen unmittelbar in ein Produkt bringen, das bereits von Menschen genutzt wird. Wir arbeiten AI-first, mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

--------
Aufgaben
--------

* Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung unserer mobilen App für *iOS & Android*
* Features von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Release eigenständig umsetzen
* Nutzerprobleme verstehen und daraus konkrete Produktlösungen entwickeln
* *UI/UX gestalten* , Prototypen erstellen und Lösungen schnell testen und iterieren
* Gemeinsam mit den Foundern Produktentscheidungen treffen und neue Ideen in funktionierende Features übersetzen
* *Claude Code, Figma AI und weitere AI-Tools* nutzen, um schneller zu entwickeln und zu iterieren
* Nutzerfeedback auswerten und direkt in Produktverbesserungen übersetzen
* Testing und *QA* übernehmen und eine hohe Produktqualität sicherstellen
* Bugs und UX-Probleme selbstständig erkennen und beheben
* Technische Strukturen und Entwicklungsprozesse kontinuierlich verbessern
* Neue Technologien ausprobieren und sinnvoll in Luma Life integrieren

*Wichtig:* Du arbeitest nicht einfach Tickets aus einem fertigen Backlog ab. Du begleitest Features *von der Problemstellung über Produkt und Design bis zur technischen Umsetzung* und übernimmst dafür echte Ownership.

-------------
Qualifikation
-------------

* Erfahrung in der *App- oder Frontend-Entwicklung* , idealerweise im Mobile-Bereich
* Sehr gutes Verständnis für moderne *iOS- und Android-Entwicklung*
* Fähigkeit, Features *eigenständig von Grund auf zu bauen* und bis zum Release zu begleiten
* Sehr gutes Gespür für *UI/UX und Produktdesign*
* Erfahrung mit *Figma* , idealerweise auch mit Figma AI
* Intensive Erfahrung mit *Claude Code oder vergleichbaren AI-Coding-Tools*
* Ausgeprägtes Produktverständnis: Du denkst in *Usern, Problemen und Lösungen* , nicht nur in Code
* Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Lernbereitschaft und *Ownership*
* Sicherer Umgang mit Testing und *QA*
* Fähigkeit, dich schnell und selbstständig in neue Technologien und Problemstellungen einzuarbeiten
* Pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Dinge selbst in die Hand zu nehmen
* Sehr gute bis exzellente *Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift* , da Sprache ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Produkts ist

--------
Benefits
--------

* *Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern* und extrem kurze Entscheidungswege
* *Großer Gestaltungsspielraum:* Du entscheidest mit, was wir bauen und wie wir es bauen
* *Echte Ownership:* Von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Feature
* *AI-first Arbeitsweise:* Claude Code, Figma AI und weitere moderne AI-Tools gehören zu unserem Alltag
* *Direkter Impact:* Deine Arbeit wird unmittelbar von echten Nutzern verwendet
* *Startup statt Konzern:* Wenig Bürokratie, schnelle Entscheidungen und viel Eigenverantwortung
* *Gesellschaftliche Mission:* Du arbeitest an einem Produkt, das Menschen mit Demenz und ihre Angehörigen im Alltag unterstützt
* *Share Options* bei entsprechender Leistung und langfristigem Commitment
* *Aufbauphase:* Du bist früh dabei und kannst Produkt, Team und Unternehmenskultur aktiv mitgestalten

Du willst nicht nur Features entwickeln, sondern *ein Produkt von Grund auf mitgestalten* ? Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, AI intensiv zu nutzen und Dinge einfach auszuprobieren und zu bauen?

Dann würden wir dich sehr gerne kennenlernen.

Schick uns deinen *CV* und gerne Links zu Projekten, Apps oder GitHub. Uns interessiert weniger ein perfekter Lebenslauf als das, *was du tatsächlich bauen kannst*.

*Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!*

title: Education Designer: UX, UI, and AI
description:
*Headquarters:* Denmark
*URL:*

You're a designer who has facilitated workshops or built online courses, and you noticed that *you loved it and that you were unusually good at it*.

You know how to make complex skills easy to learn, and how to guide people in applying their new skills. As one of our Education Designers, you'll structure and create the courses and Master Classes you lead.

You've taught design or AI to hundreds of people. Now you get the opportunity to *teach it to hundreds of thousands* of learners around the world.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include *Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman* , as well as Design Leads at *Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe*. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to *take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow*. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

--------------------------------------------------------
Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education
--------------------------------------------------------

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us *take online education to new heights* and *make a meaningful impact on humankind*.

At IxDF, we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

------------------------------------------------
We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team
------------------------------------------------

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

*

*Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:* lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there. *This is the role described here.*

*

*Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:* lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our *Education Designers*.

*

*Our Course Writers and Editors:* lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

*You, the Education Designer,* establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course. You create the sequences, exercises, templates, and assessments. You'll work closely with our *Co-Founder* , your *Team Lead* , and the *Course Directors* , who lead on what we teach and who teaches it, and you'll have a real say in both. We all reach out to and collaborate with industry leaders in these processes. Once your course is ready, our *Course Writers and Editors* take it the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

-----------------
Your Role at IxDF
-----------------

*

*Be a core part of our Editorial Team.* You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

*

*Design for a diverse, global audience.* Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, you'll teach both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

*

*Make an impact as you decide how the courses you lead come together.* You establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course, then you plan, structure, and create the core content that gets them there. What comes first, what builds on what, and how people level up step by step with ease and joy from confused to competent. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

*

Design the exercises, portfolio activities, design templates, and assessments that *turn passive watching into active designing*. You write the exercises that make a course participant apply an idea to their own portfolio project, the templates that scaffold that work, and the assessments that reveal whether they understood and can apply it, or whether they just watched. You write the headings and hooks your structure calls for, and our Course Writers and Editors own the final wording. Every course should leave a participant with a portfolio case study they can show a hiring manager.

*

*Set and raise the standard for our assessments,* so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests.

*

*Make expert knowledge understandable.* You take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches timeless human-centered design and AI.

*

*You help produce Master Classes.* We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session. *Timelines vary enormously* : with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Course Directors and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

*

You *plan the course content in collaboration with the global industry leaders* in design and then *fly out to meet them in professional studios across the world*. You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On average *we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.*

*

*Our courses combine written and video lessons.* You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective. You'll also work closely with our growth team.

*

*Balance the big picture with the smaller details.* Expect to focus on *one large course creation project per quarter* , alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published.

*

*Find room for improvement* by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

*

*Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentation* so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

*

*You won't do this alone.* You'll work with our Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the structure: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether it holds together. That kind of judgment takes twenty years to build, and this type of collaboration is one of the fastest ways to grow your own design skills. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll grow personally and professionally.

*

*We’re committed to excellence,* and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role is not for the average. Ahead of you is a highly rewarding and enriching journey.

*

We're proud to have assembled a *remarkable team of unicorns* who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

---------
About You
---------

*

You have at least *5 years of hands-on design experience*.

*

You've *facilitated workshops* repeatedly, run a beginner course, mentored designers, or built curricula for online courses.

*

You can *show us something you built* : a course, a workshop series, live Master Classes, an AI teaching app, or a mentoring program. We’re excited to hear what it was, why you built it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

*

You can take a *broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequence* that’ll make a beginner feel and act confident.

*

You can teach the same idea in different formats: a 60-minute workshop, a written lesson, a 90-second video. You know what a medium does well and what it can't carry, and you know what to cut when the format gets shorter.

*

You're a *practical idealist*. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

*

You *collaborate with AI in everything you do*. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to take *human leadership* , so the *outcome is 100% yours* and better than you could have created without AI.

*

You know the difference between *timeless human-centered design skills and skills in tools that change*. You’re passionate about the first, because they’re the most interesting to you and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon. You’re eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know they’re more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

*

You can *teach a career changer* the powerful skills of great design, and you can *guide an experienced designer* in upskilling to a more senior role.

*

You're genuinely *curious* about how AI is changing design work and design education.

*

You're kind, and you have the *social intelligence and empathy* to engage well with very different kinds of people.

*

You're *fluent in written and spoken English* and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

*

You’re enthusiastic about learning by doing and are *committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills*.

*

You *spot problems* before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

*

You *value teamwork* , prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals. You give constructive feedback that others can act on, and you take it the same way. When someone shows you how your idea could be better, you're interested rather than defensive.

*

You're *self-motivated* , and you love *creative freedom* , *independent judgment* , and the *responsibility* that comes with both.

*

You’re driven by the desire to *make a positive impact in the world* and to improve the lives of others.

*

Most of the work happens from your *home office,* but you're *willing to travel a few times a year* to shoot courses. You're located in a *time zone* between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

------------
Bonus Points
------------

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

*

You've *published* educational material under your own name or *spoken* at design conferences.

*

You've worked with an *LMS or an online learning platform*.

*

You've *built AI-supported learning* : tutors, adaptive paths, automated feedback. Or you’ve used AI to build products.

*

You hold a *bachelor's or master's* in UX, UI, AI, or a similar field.

*

You have your *own blog or social media page* where you create and share original content.

*

You have *collaborated with video production teams*.

-----------------
What We Can Offer
-----------------

*

*A highly valued role:* You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

*

*Reach and impact* that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. A workshop facilitator might teach one hundred designers a year. Your design decisions will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

*

*Access:* ** The experts you'd normally cite in a workshop are the people whose material you'll be shaping, whose Master Classes you'll produce, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling.

*

*Autonomy:* Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses teach.

*

*A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotely* alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by a *common mission* to create the best possible design and AI education in the world, and make it accessible for everyone.

*

*Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you*. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

*

A *full-time position* within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production.

*

Bi-weekly *knowledge-sharing sessions* and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

*

A work culture with no *fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama*. Your colleagues value *your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver*. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

*

A daily mission to help impact, *empower, and enrich the lives of millions of people* by creating *affordable high-end design education* for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

*

*Colleagues with four to forty years of experience* , and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest résumé.

*

A company *where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.* We're a highly agile organization with *zero bureaucracy or corporate politics* – and with *exceptional order and efficiency*.

*

A company culture where *passion meets high performance and excellence*. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process, *you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline*.

*

We thrive because we have a *hands-on attitude and a bias towards action* as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll need *crisp execution skills yourself* and the ability to *impress your colleagues with concrete results* , just like they'll impress you.

*

If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, you’re in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then you’ll find virtually *limitless opportunities with us.*

*

We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at the *forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it*. You'll help *set a direction* that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.

---------------------------
How to Learn More and Apply
---------------------------

To submit your application as well as learn more about our Work Culture and Values, please visit https://ixdf.org/about/careers

Please apply as soon as you can. We’re firm believers in “the sooner, the better” and we look forward to working with you!

title: E-Comm Static Ads Designer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a E-Comm Static Ads Designer based in India.*

This role is focused on creating high-volume, high-converting static advertising creative for e-commerce and performance marketing campaigns.
You’ll design assets that are built to capture attention quickly, communicate compelling value propositions, and drive measurable action.
The work spans Meta, Pinterest, Google Display, and programmatic advertising, with opportunities to explore a wide range of visual styles.
You’ll balance polished brand design with direct-response and UGC-inspired creative designed for performance.
Rapid experimentation is central to the role, with frequent iteration of winning concepts, headlines, backgrounds, layouts, and calls to action.
You’ll work in a remote-first, asynchronous environment that prioritizes output, speed, creative thinking, and focused deep work.
Your portfolio and ability to demonstrate the strategic thinking behind successful performance creative will be key to your success.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Design high-performance static advertisements for Meta, Pinterest, Google Display, and programmatic campaigns, with a strong focus on engagement and conversion.
* Create a broad range of creative formats and styles, from UGC-inspired and unconventional direct-response graphics to polished, premium brand layouts.
* Develop carousels, split-screen comparisons, “Us vs. Them” graphics, checklists, press-style listicles, and other performance-oriented formats.
* Develop compelling visual hooks that capture attention quickly and communicate a clear value proposition within seconds.
* Rapidly iterate on successful concepts by testing alternative headlines, backgrounds, typography, layouts, CTAs, and other creative elements.
* Produce multiple variations of high-performing concepts efficiently to support ongoing creative testing and campaign scaling.
* Maintain an organized design library that enables efficient versioning, reuse, and optimization across advertising platforms.
* Apply strong visual hierarchy, typography, composition, and contrast to guide users toward the intended action.
* Use performance insights and campaign feedback to refine creative direction and improve future iterations.
* Collaborate asynchronously with the wider team while maintaining a consistent daily overlap of approximately 2–3 hours for feedback, creative discussions, and troubleshooting.

*Requirements*

Landeed | YC provided pay range

This range is provided by Landeed | YC. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

₹1,000,000.00/yr - ₹2,400,000.00/yr

You'll Define How a Country Interacts With Its Land.

We've solved the hard back-end — document mapping and real-time access across 20+ state databases. What we're hiring for is how it should feel. Fast. Clear. Like this is how land should always have worked.

What You'll Own

- End-to-end design across mobile and web. Government-heavy data turned into something that lands in seconds.
- The full spread of India. Non-English speakers, first-time smartphone users, and power users, who live in the product all day. The same screen has to work for all of them.
- Our design system. Tokens, components, states, motion. Work inside it, extend it where it's thin, keep it honest.
- The brand. Landing pages, ads, social, brand assets. India's first land-tech brand is still being written.
- Real surface area. Small team, no layers. You present your own work to the people who decide.

What We're Screening For

We don't expect all four. Two genuinely strong, real curiosity in the other two. A designer who's mildly good at everything has no edge, we'd rather have the edge.

-  Design thinking - can you get from fog to a screen you can defend? You start from the user's situation, not from a Dribbble reference. You explore more than one direction before committing, and you can show the ones you killed. You can say why this layout and not that one, in words a non-designer follows. Your final screen looks inevitable, getting there wasn't.
-  Product thinking - You can name the job. You can finish this sentence about anything you design: "I am on this screen to ___." You understand the business without letting it drive, "it converts better" is not an argument here, it's the thing we check against. You think past the happy path: back, abandon, interrupt, resume, repeat use, the support ticket it creates. And you know what every choice costs you somewhere else.
-  Systems thinking - can you absorb variance instead of passing it on? This is the capability we weigh most heavily, and the one most portfolios fake. Can you hold altitude and detail simultaneously? The thing we're hiring for is not losing one while you're inside the other. Zoom out far enough to see the whole flow, the business, the org, the market, the ecosystem. Then zoom all the way into a 4px alignment, a tap target on a cracked screen, the exact word on a button. You notice when a new pattern is an old pattern in a new coat, and you consolidate instead of adding. Can you think in second order?
-  Brand and craft - do you have a voice, and can you hold it? Brand is not a phase that happens after the wireframes. It is a constraint you carry into the wireframe. You know removing something is usually the stronger move. You know the difference between brand and decoration. Brand is the accumulated feeling of a thousand small decisions being consistent. It is not a gradient. You can carry one identity across an ad, an app screen and an email without it fraying.

How We Work

- We ship weekly. Your work hits real hands fast, and fails there fast.
- Our standard is written down. No claim ships without its proof on the same surface. No fear, no pressure, no countdown timers. People are making the largest purchase of their lives, we don't get to be clever about it.
- We don't average. Every surface declares the one thing it's exceptional at. Balanced work is failed work.
- Feedback is direct and it's about the work. We'll teach you land records. We can't teach you judgment.
- In-office, Hyderabad.

Must-haves

You've shipped something real and can say what it taught you. Fluency in Figma. Clear written English, you'll write product copy from week one. Obsessed with how people feel using a product, not just how it looks. And AI-native, not AI-dependent, AI should raise your ceiling, not set your floor.

How To Apply

Show us what you've built, portfolio plus the questions below.

-  Tell us about one project where the design was wrong the first time and you fixed it. What was wrong, and how you knew. (A short paragraph.)
-  One thing you'd change about Landeed today, flow, brand or visual, your choice and why. (Use the product first. The "why" matters more than the "what".)
